content: Drone Domestic Incursion . Book not a series .  Military begins to roll out Autonomous drones powered by low level Computer Intelligence, however what they don’t know is there is an exploit one that was passed to  a   extremist group, using the armies own drones, they steal ten of them and send them against the US with two city bombings by drone .  They steal the drones and store  them,   they  use them to drop bombs over two major cities.  Broadcasting a list of demands the authorities are reeling from the attacks as they desperately try to track down the remaining drones .
